rows.note: Use 轉車 for changing from one public-transport vehicle or line to another during a journey.

example.english: The transfer at Kowloon Tong is convenient.
example.jyutping: hai2 gau2 lung4 tong4 zyun2 ce1 hou2 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use 轉移 as the all-purpose noun for the act of moving or conveying something from one place, person, or thing to another.

example.english: The transfer of these files has been completed.
example.traditional: 呢批檔案嘅轉移已經完成。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 dong2 ngon3 ge3 zyun2 ji4 ji5 ging1 jyun4 sing4

rows.note: Use this specifically when changing from one bus, train, or transit line to another.

example.english: I transfer at Mong Kok Station to get to Tsim Sha Tsui.
example.traditional: 我喺旺角站轉車去尖沙咀。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 wong6 gok3 zaam6 zyun2 ce1 heoi3 zim1 saa1 zeoi2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for moving or transferring A from one place or destination to another.

example.english: I transfer from the Kowloon branch to the Causeway Bay branch.
example.traditional: 我由九龍分店轉去銅鑼灣分店。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau4 gau2 lung4 fan1 dim3 zyun2 heoi3 tung4 lo4 waan1 fan1 dim3

rows.note: Use this when passing or forwarding something from yourself or one person to another person.

example.english: Can you transfer the document to Ming?
example.traditional: 可唔可以將份文件轉畀阿明？
example.jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 fan6 man4 gin6 zyun2 bei2 aa3 ming4

rows.note: Use this for officially transferring ownership or registration of property or an account.

example.english: The transfer of the flat into my name is complete.
example.jyutping: cang4 lau4 ji5 ging1 gwo3 wu6 bei2 ngo5 laa3
